coreResponsibility.summary: A Kaltura Player UI plugin that provides a customizable slate overlay component for displaying informational messages, loading states, and interactive prompts during video playback.

featureOwnership: Player pause/resume state handling during slate display
Customizable slate content (title, message, background image)
Loading spinner display in slate overlay
Custom action button support with event dispatch
Pre-roll slate support via media metadata tags
dataHandling: SlateOptions configuration object (title, message, backgroundImageUrl, showSpinner, timeout, buttons)
SlateConfig plugin configuration (imageOnMediaLoad, titleOnMediaLoad, messageOnMediaLoad, dismissTextOnMediaLoad)
Player playback state tracking (wasPlayed flag for resume behavior)
Player size state (from Redux store for responsive spinner sizing)
uiComponents: Slate - Main overlay component with title, message, spinner, and buttons
SlateManager - Service class for adding/removing slates programmatically

upstream: @playkit-js/kaltura-player-js - Core player providing BasePlugin, UI components, Redux store, and player controls
@playkit-js/playkit-js - Core playback engine providing FakeEvent and FakeEventTarget for event handling
@playkit-js/playkit-js-ui - UI framework providing Overlay component, preact i18n, Redux connect, and ReservedPresetAreas
@playkit-js/common - Shared UI components (Button, Spinner, OverlayPortal, A11yWrapper)
downstream: Host applications consuming Kaltura Player with slate plugin enabled
KMS (Kaltura Management System) edit pages using slate for presenter overlays
Any Kaltura Player integration requiring informational overlays during playback

entryPoints.purpose: Plugin registration entry point - registers SlatePlugin with Kaltura Player
Main plugin class extending BasePlugin - handles lifecycle, config, and SlateManager instantiation
Core service logic - manages slate overlay lifecycle (add/remove), pause/resume behavior, and event dispatch
Main UI component - renders overlay with title, message, spinner, and action buttons
